scope: All remaining 12 of 20 assigned locations; one assigned area slice is explicitly distinguished from full parent membership.

methods.osm: Retained OSM API extracts retrieved 2026-10-02; directed coastline ways joined by node endpoints, CCW rings treated as land and CW contained rings as water; report preserves every source way, source version timestamp and land component, topology gaps and areas. Complete closed ring reconstruction does not prove complete modern shoreline.
methods.gshhg: GSHHG full resolution 2.3.7 source families and candidate components selected by gazetteer coordinate within declared search envelope; envelope is not boundary, polygons not clipped. Full component inventory, IDs, bounds, vertices and area retained from report.json. Released 2017-06-15; comparison source is historical/generalized and not modern completeness proof.
methods.units: Areas are source measurements, not official area determinations; component counts are not island quotas.

sources.openstreetmap_license: ODbL 1.0; attribution OpenStreetMap contributors; raw compressed bytes retained in named paths under macro-coverage-oceania; per-row URL/archive/hash in OSM report. Preserve old vintage, never overwrite.
sources.gshhg_license: LGPLv3 or later per extraction manifest; native source archive/member hashes and extraction procedure are in manifest; 2.3.7 released 2017-06-15.
official_sources: Cook Islands OPM Pa Enua Governance, https://www.pmoffice.gov.ck/our-work/pa-enua/, retrieved 2026-10-03, page hash and byte count in README; no reuse license stated; restore from canonical URL and record new hash.

Cook Islands Statistics Office 2021 Census, https://stats.gov.ck/download/83/census-2021/1497/2021-census-report-with-tables-and-questionnaire.pdf, census enumeration 2021-12-01, retrieved 2026-10-03, hash and byte count in README; no reuse license stated.

Cook Islands Atiu and Takutea Environment Regulations 2008, https://environment.gov.ck/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Environment-Atiu-and-Takutea-Regulations-2008.pdf, retrieved 2026-10-03; hash and bytes in README; no open reuse license stated.

Kiribati Southern Line Islands Marine Protected Area Regulations 2020, https://www.president.gov.ki/images/Gazettes/SLIMPR20.pdf, July 2020, retrieved 2026-10-03; hash and bytes in README; no open reuse license stated.

Government of Pitcairn Laws Volume I (2017 revised edition), https://www.government.pn/s/Revised-Laws-of-Pitcairn-Henderson-Ducie-and-Oeno-Islands-2017-Rev-Ed-Volume-1.pdf, retrieved 2026-10-03; hash and bytes in README; no reuse license stated.

Northern Cook Islands.finding: Pukapuka/Nassau combined Island Government is supported by OPM; do not infer boundary/ownership from governance name.

Cook Islands.finding: Label is ambiguous because the northern islands are represented in a separate Northern Cook area; clarify intended southern/central scope with regional integration, do not change membership here.

Line Islands.finding: Kiribati 2020 statute names Flint, Volstok, Starbuck, Malden and Millenium (Caroline); it does not include Kingman (handled by #544), establish province tier, or resolve the retained Gilbert/Line ADM1 crosswalk (#611). Coordinate #404/#611; no shared parent changes.

Pitcairn Islands.finding: Official laws identify the named four-island group. Area physical/legal group role is supported; an additional coextensive Province tier has no independent civil role evidence in sources reviewed and remains unresolved. Henderson is out of scope and not reassessed.
